mapper.select: with A as( select A.*, fp.trade_market, fp.profit_type, nvl(fp.finprod_Name,fp.finprod_abbr) finprodName, decode(ftp.type_8,'F02','02','F11','06','F01','01','F04','10','F09','11') secType from ( /*前一天头寸*/ select distinct A.BOOKSET_ID, A.BUSI_ID, A.INV_AIM, a.portfolio_id, a.portfolio_name, a.institution_code from( select bsdp.*, pp.portfolio_id, pp.portfolio_name, sd.institution_code, rank() over(partition by BOOKSET_ID,BOK_DETAIL_ID order by BOOK_SUMMARY_ORDER desc)rn from BOK_STAT_DET_POSIITON bsdp left join ptl_portfolio pp on (case when bsdp.BOOKSET_ID like '%_F28_%' THEN regexp_replace(substr(bsdp.BOOKSET_ID,0, INSTR(bsdp.BOOKSET_ID, '_F28_', 1, 1)-1), '^F16_','') else regexp_replace(bsdp.BOOKSET_ID, '^F16_','') end ) = pp.portfolio_id left join sys_department sd on nvl(pp.create_dept,bsdp.create_dept) = sd.dept_code where bsdp.BOOK_DATE = #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}-1 and bsdp.HAPPEN_DATE = #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}-1 and bsdp.POS_AMT!=0 )a union /*当天交易*/ select distinct bda.bookset_id, deal.finprod_id, deal.inv_aim, pp.portfolio_id, pp.portfolio_name, sd.institution_code from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING bda on bda.busi_no = deal.trade_Id and bda.BUSI_TABLE = '02' left join trd_product_deal_add tpda on tpda.trade_id = deal.trade_id left join ptl_portfolio pp on (case when bda.BOOKSET_ID like '%_F28_%' then regexp_replace(substr(bda.BOOKSET_ID,0, INSTR(bda.BOOKSET_ID, '_F28_', 1, 1)-1), '^F16_','') else regexp_replace(bda.BOOKSET_ID, '^F16_','') end) = pp.portfolio_id or (case when tpda.portfolio_id like '%_F28_%' then regexp_replace(substr(tpda.portfolio_id,0, INSTR(tpda.portfolio_id, '_F28_', 1, 1)-1), '^F16_','') else regexp_replace(tpda.portfolio_id, '^F16_','') end) = pp.portfolio_id left join sys_department sd on nvl(pp.create_dept,deal.create_dept) = sd.dept_code where deal.trade_date = #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} )A inner join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id = A.busi_id inner join fin_product_type ftp on ftp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where ftp.type_8 in ('F02','F11','F01','F04','F09') ), /*一般估值方案配置*/ B as( select A.BOOKSET_ID,a.busi_id,a.inv_aim from A inner join BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN bbp on bbp.BOOKSET_ID = a.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL bvsd on bbp.SCHEME_ID = bvsd.SCHEME_ID and bvsd.vdate <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} and ( ( bvsd.sec_type in ('10','11') and ( A.INV_AIM IS NULL OR nvl(a.inv_aim,'FVTPL') = NVL(bvsd.inv_Aim,'FVTPL') ) ) or ( bvsd.sec_type in ('02') and a.profit_type != '03' ) or ( nvl(a.inv_aim,'999999') = NVL(bvsd.inv_Aim,'999999') ) ) AND (A.trade_market IS NULL OR A.trade_market = bvsd.trade_market) and a.secType = bvsd.sec_type ), /*特殊估值方案配置*/ C as( select A.BOOKSET_ID,a.busi_id,a.inv_aim from A inner join BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN bbp on bbp.BOOKSET_ID = a.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL_SPECIAL bvsd on bvsd.SCHEME_ID = bbp.SCHEME_ID and bvsd.vdate <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} and (bvsd.mdate is null or bvsd.mdate >= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}) and bvsd.finprod_id = a.busi_id and nvl(a.inv_aim,'999999') = NVL(bvsd.inv_Aim,'999999') ) select DISTINCT A.portfolio_id portfolioId, A.portfolio_name portfolioName, A.busi_id finprodId, a.finprodName finprodName, a.bookset_id, a.institution_code instCode FROM a WHERE NOT exists (select 1 from B where a.BOOKSET_ID = b.BOOKSET_ID and a.busi_id = b.busi_id and nvl(a.inv_aim,'999999') = NVL(b.inv_Aim,'999999') ) and ( a.secType in ('01','06','10','11') or ( a.secType = '02' and a.profit_type != '03' ) ) and not exists(select 1 from c where a.BOOKSET_ID = c.BOOKSET_ID and a.busi_id = c.busi_id and a.inv_aim = c.inv_aim)
